primary.title: Nicomachean Ethics
primary.author: Aristotle
primary.rationale: Aristotle's seminal work on ethics, virtue, and the good life. It is a foundational text in Western philosophy.

primary.title: Politics
primary.author: Aristotle
primary.rationale: Aristotle's examination of political science, governance, and the ideal state. It is a key text for understanding ancient political thought.

primary.title: Metaphysics
primary.author: Aristotle
primary.rationale: Aristotle's exploration of fundamental questions about reality, existence, and first principles. It is a cornerstone of philosophical inquiry.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Aristotle
secondary.author: Jonathan Barnes
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Aristotle's philosophy and works.

secondary.title: Aristotle's Nicomachean Ethics: A Commentary
secondary.author: Terence Irwin
secondary.rationale: A detailed and influential scholarly commentary on Aristotle's most famous ethical work, providing in-depth analysis and interpretation.

secondary.title: Aristotle's Political Theory: An Introduction
secondary.author: Christopher Bobonich
secondary.rationale: An accessible yet rigorous introduction to Aristotle's political philosophy, examining his key concepts and arguments.

suggestions.notes: Aristotle's works are foundational to Western thought, and many of his major treatises are widely available in translation in digital archives. The secondary sources listed are standard scholarly introductions and commentaries.
